summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Will Sherman, an American football defensive back. It gives his birth and death dates and states that he played for the Los Angeles Rams of the National Football League from 1954 to 1960.
one_line: Will Sherman was an American football defensive back who played for the NFL's Los Angeles Rams from 1954 to 1960.
key_facts: Will Sherman was born on October 20, 1927.
Will Sherman was an American football defensive back.
Will Sherman played with the National Football League's Los Angeles Rams.
Will Sherman played for the Los Angeles Rams from 1954 to 1960.
